```{r}
library(RColorBrewer)
library(pheatmap)
library(scales)
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)
```


# Data

LOLA was performed for DM, hyper-, and hypomethylated Cgs between the stomach regions using all Cgs of the normalized data set as the universe.

Here I visualize the all results, including the collections * Cistrome Epigenome
* Encode Segmentation
* Encode TFBS
* UCSC Features

```{r}
load( "../../../../Data/ExtData/Other_Methylation_data/GSE210994_Leung_IMO/LOLA_Core_results.Rdata")

```


# LOLA Visualization

## Overview of significantly enriched genomic features

```{r}
all_results = all_results_lola

all_results <- lapply(all_results, function(x) {
  x2 <- x[,c("collection", "logOddsRatio", "description", "cellType", "tissue", "antibody", "treatment", "p.adj")] 
    return(x2)
  }
)

#rename the logOddsRatio which was labeled wrong (in our modified copy of runLOLA; fixed meanwhile in R package v1.28)

all_results <- lapply(all_results, function(x) {
  colnames(x) <- c("collection", "OddsRatio", "description", "cellType", "tissue", "antibody", "treatment", "p.adj")
    return(x)
  })


all_results <- lapply(all_results, function(x)  { cbind(x, logOddsRatio = log2(x[,"OddsRatio"]))  })


subsetLOLA_res <- 

all_results <- lapply(all_results, function(x) {
  colnames(x) <- c("collection", "OddsRatio", "description", "cellType", "tissue", "antibody", "treatment", "p.adj", "logOddsRatio")
    return(x)
  })



all_results<- lapply(all_results, function(x) {
 x2 <-  subset(x, (!complete.cases(x[,"treatment"])) | treatment == "None" | treatment == "No treatment" | treatment == "regular medium" | treatment == "serum_starved_media" | treatment == "serum_stimulated_media" | treatment == "full media" | treatment == "mock" | treatment == "No treatment(Antibody RAR _A704)" | treatment == "No treatment(Antibody RXR _sc774)")
return(x2)
  })


for(dd in names(all_results)){
  x = table(all_results[[dd]]$collection, all_results[[dd]]$p.adj < 0.05 & all_results[[dd]]$logOddsRatio > 0, dnn = c("Collection", paste(names(all_results[dd]), "\n                   sign. enriched (FDR < 5%)", sep = "")))
print(x)
  }
```


## Overview of significantly depleted genomic features

```{r}
for(dd in names(all_results)){
  x = table(all_results[[dd]]$collection, all_results[[dd]]$p.adj < 0.05 & all_results[[dd]]$logOddsRatio < 0, dnn = c("Collection", paste(names(all_results[dd]), "\n                   sign. depleted (FDR < 5%)", sep = "")))
print(x)
}
```

```{r}
subsetLOLA_res <- function(x) {
  
  subset(x, p.adj < 0.05)
  }

all_results <- lapply(all_results, subsetLOLA_res)


# there are some rows with -infinite logOdssRatios (which means Oddsratio = 0). Remove them

subsetLOLA_res <- function(x){
   subset(x, OddsRatio != 0)
 }

all_results <- lapply(all_results, subsetLOLA_res)
```


```{r}
subsetLOLA_res <- function(x){
  subset(x, collection == "cistrome_epigenome" | collection == "encode_tfbs" | collection == "encode_segmentation" | collection == "ucsc_features")
}

all_results = lapply(all_results, subsetLOLA_res)

# determine legend colors for all collections:

# color_fun = function(x){
#   min(x$logOddsRatio)
# }
# 
# lapply(all_results, color_fun)


breaksList = seq(-7.8, 5.4, by = 0.6)

# 13 blues and 9 yellows

colors_blue = brewer_pal("seq")(8)
colors_blue = gradient_n_pal(colors_blue)(seq(0,1,length.out = 13))

colors_yell = brewer_pal("seq", "YlOrRd")(8)
colors_yell = gradient_n_pal(colors_yell[1:6])(seq(0,1,length.out = 9))

colors = c(rev(colors_blue), colors_yell)
```

## Cistrome-Epigenome

```{r}
cisepi <- lapply(all_results, function(x) subset(x, collection == "cistrome_epigenome") )
cisepi <- lapply(cisepi, function(x) {x[order(x$logOddsRatio),]; return(x)} ) 
cisepi <- lapply(cisepi, function(x) {x = x[, c("logOddsRatio", "cellType", "antibody")]; return(x)}  )

# select histone marks

sel_h_marks = c("H3K4me3",
                 "H3K9me3",
                 "H3K27me3",
                 "H3K36me3",
                 "H3K9ac",
                 "H3K14ac",
                 "H3K27ac",
                 "H3K4me1")

# H3K4me3 is enriched in transcriptionally active promoters
# H3K9me3 is found in constitutively repressed genes
# H3K27me3 is found in facultatively repressed genes
# H3K36me3 is found in actively transcribed gene bodies
# H3K9ac is found in actively transcribed promoters
# H3K14ac is found in actively transcribed promoters
# H3K27ac distinguishes active enhancers from poised enhancers

cisepi = lapply(cisepi, function(x) subset(x, antibody %in% sel_h_marks))

# determine breaks list

# funfun = function(x){
#  max(x$logOddsRatio)
# }
# 
# bb = lapply(cisepi, funfun)
# bb

# 12 blues, 3 reds, when all TFs are included.

#breaksList = seq(-4.8, 1.8, by = 0.6)
#breaksList = seq(-7.2, 3, by = 0.6)

#colors =  c("#FC4E2A", "#FEB24C", "#FFFFCC", "#F7FBFF", "#DEEBF7", "#C6DBEF", "#9ECAE1", "#6BAED6", "#4292C6", "#2171B5", "#08519C")


# colors_blue = brewer_pal("seq")(8)
# colors_blue = gradient_n_pal(colors_blue)(seq(0,1,length.out = 12))
# 
# colors_yell = brewer_pal("seq", "YlOrRd")(8)
# colors_yell = gradient_n_pal(colors_yell[1:6])(seq(0,1,length.out = 9))
# 
# colors = c(rev(colors_blue), colors_yell[1:6])

sub_fun = function(x)
{
  if(is.null(x) || nrow(x)<1) return()
  dcast(x, formula = antibody ~ cellType, value.var = "logOddsRatio")
}

cisepi = lapply(cisepi, sub_fun)

for(dd in names(cisepi)){
  if(is.null(cisepi[[dd]]) || nrow(cisepi[[dd]]) < 1 ) next
  rownames(cisepi[[dd]]) <- cisepi[[dd]]$antibody
  cisepi[[dd]]$antibody = NULL
  pheatmap(cisepi[[dd]], cluster_rows = F, cluster_cols = F, main = as.character(dd), color = colorRampPalette(colors)(length(breaksList)), breaks = breaksList, cellwidth = 15, cellheight = 15)  }
```


## Encode Segmentation

```{r}
sub_fun <- function(x) {
  
  subset(x, collection == "encode_segmentation")
}

encseg <- lapply(all_results, sub_fun)

encseg <- lapply(encseg, function(x){x[order(x$logOddsRatio),]})


encseg_fun <- function(x){
cbind(x, info = paste(x$description, "\n", "(", x$cellType, ")"))
  }

encseg <- lapply(encseg, encseg_fun)


sub_fun <- function(x)
  {
  x = x[, c("logOddsRatio", "cellType", "description")]
}

encseg = lapply(encseg, sub_fun)

# determine breaks list

# funfun = function(x){
#  max(x$logOddsRatio)
# }
# 
# bb = lapply(encseg, funfun)
# bb

# breaksList = seq(-6, 3, by = 0.6)
# 
# colors = c(rev(colors_blue[1:10]), colors_yell[1:5])b

sub_fun = function(x)
{
  if(is.null(x) || nrow(x)<1) return()
  dcast(x, formula = description ~ cellType, value.var = "logOddsRatio")
}

encseg = lapply(encseg, sub_fun)

for(dd in names(encseg)){
  rownames(encseg[[dd]]) <- encseg[[dd]]$description
  encseg[[dd]]$description = NULL
  pheatmap(encseg[[dd]], cluster_rows = F, cluster_cols = F, main = as.character(dd), color = colorRampPalette(colors)(length(breaksList)), breaks = breaksList, cellwidth = 15, cellheight = 15)
  }
```

## The ENCODE TFBS Collection

```{r}
sub_fun <- function(x) {
  
  subset(x, collection == "encode_tfbs")
}

encode_tfbs <- lapply(all_results, sub_fun)


encode_tfbs <- lapply(encode_tfbs, function(x){x[order(x$logOddsRatio),]})





# There are too many. Subset for embryonic stem cells and mammary gland cells

sel_cell_lines = c("H1hesc",
                   "Embryonic Stem Cell",
                   "H1-hESC",
                   "HUVEC",
                   "Huvec",
                   "Endoderm",
                   "Caco-2(proliferating)",
                   "Caco-2(differentiated)",
                   "HepG2 liver cells",
                   "normal liver cells",
                   "HeLa-S3",
                   "HepG2")


subsetLOLA_res <- function(x) {

subset(x, x$cellType %in% sel_cell_lines)
  }

encode_tfbs <- lapply(encode_tfbs, subsetLOLA_res)



#selected TFs:
sel_TFs = c("CTCF", "EZH2_(39875)", "Pol2", "Pol2-4H8", "Pol2(b)", "Pol2(phosphoS2", "SUZ12")

subsetLOLA_res <- function(x) {

subset(x, x$antibody %in% sel_TFs)
 }

encode_tfbs <- lapply(encode_tfbs, subsetLOLA_res)


sub_fun = function(x){
  x = x[!duplicated(x$description),]
}
#DF[!duplicated(DF$ID), ]

encode_tfbs = lapply(encode_tfbs, sub_fun)

sub_fun <- function(x){
   cbind(x, info = sapply(strsplit(x$antibody, "_", fixed = TRUE), function(x) (x[1])))
 }

encode_tfbs <- lapply(encode_tfbs, sub_fun)

sub_fun <- function(x)
  {
  x = x[, c("logOddsRatio", "cellType", "info")]
}

encode_tfbs = lapply(encode_tfbs, sub_fun)


# determine breaks list

# funfun = function(x){
#  min(x$logOddsRatio)
# }
# 
# bb = lapply(encode_tfbs, funfun)
# bb

# breaksList = seq(-6.0, 5.4, by = 0.6)
# 
# colors = c(rev(colors_blue[1:10]), colors_yell[1:9])


sub_fun = function(x)
{
  if(is.null(x) || nrow(x)<1) return()
  dcast(x, formula = info ~ cellType, value.var = "logOddsRatio")
}


encode_tfbs = lapply(encode_tfbs, sub_fun)


for(dd in names(encode_tfbs)){
      rownames(encode_tfbs[[dd]]) <- encode_tfbs[[dd]]$info
  encode_tfbs[[dd]]$info = NULL
  pheatmap(encode_tfbs[[dd]], cluster_rows = F, cluster_cols = F, main = as.character(dd), color = colorRampPalette(colors)(length(breaksList)), breaks = breaksList, cellwidth = 15, cellheight = 15)
  }
```


## The UCSC Features Collection

```{r}
sub_fun <- function(x) {
  
  subset(x, collection == "ucsc_features")
}

ucfea <- lapply(all_results, sub_fun)


ucfea <- lapply(ucfea, function(x){x[order(x$logOddsRatio),]})


ucfea_fun <- function(x){
  cbind(x, info = gsub("UCSC", "", x$description))
}

ucfea <- lapply(ucfea, ucfea_fun)



sub_fun <- function(x)
  {
  x = x[, c("logOddsRatio", "info")]
}

ucfea = lapply(ucfea, sub_fun)


# determine breaks list

# funfun = function(x){
#  max(x$logOddsRatio)
# }
# 
# bb = lapply(ucfea, funfun)
# bb
# 
# breaksList = seq(-3.6, 4.2, by = 0.6)
# 
# colors = c(rev(colors_blue[1:6]), colors_yell[1:7])

for(dd in names(ucfea)){
      rownames(ucfea[[dd]]) <- ucfea[[dd]]$info
  ucfea[[dd]]$info = NULL
  pheatmap(ucfea[[dd]], cluster_rows = F, cluster_cols = F, main = as.character(dd), color = colorRampPalette(colors)(length(breaksList)), breaks = breaksList, cellwidth = 15, cellheight = 15, show_colnames = F)
  }
```
